<thought>I will locate a retrosynthetic template that disconnects a sulfonamide into a sulfonyl chloride and an aniline. In the forward direction a sulfonyl chloride reacts with an amine to give a sulfonamide, so the broken functional groups are “primary amines” (the aniline nitrogen) and the formed group is “sulfonamides”. I will search the template catalog for this transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["primary amines"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
